name: ModelVariant797_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant797_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (two glowing flares beside a model part spin sixteen rays each while the light dims, then animated strikes land on the opposing slot and periodic bursts there flash and fade with sixteen double rays); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the strikes and burst rays and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the hold time, 4 from the hold time until the emission ends, 1 once when it ends, 2 after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-814 and 911 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
